text_markup: If an ability that plays an event or operation also contains the nested conditional ability "After it resolves, remove it from the game.", the event or operation is not trashed. The card remains in the play area until the conditional ability removes it from the game.
text_plain: If an ability that plays an event or operation also contains the nested conditional ability "After it resolves, remove it from the game.", the event or operation is not trashed. The card remains in the play area until the conditional ability removes it from the game.
